context_ids = tokenizer.encode(context, add_special_tokens=False)
print('Context ids: ' + str(context_ids))

for t in scierc_types:
    bare_ids = tokenizer.encode(t, add_special_tokens=False)
    full = context + t
    full_ids = tokenizer.encode(full, add_special_tokens=False)
    type_ids = full_ids[len(context_ids):]
    match = 'SAME' if type_ids == bare_ids else 'DIFFERENT'
    print('  ' + t + ': bare=' + str(bare_ids) + ', in_context=' + str(type_ids) + ', ' + match)

print()
print('DocRED types:')
docred_types = ['PER', 'ORG', 'LOC', 'TIME', 'NUM', 'MISC']
for t in docred_types:
    bare_ids = tokenizer.encode(t, add_special_tokens=False)
    full = context + t
    full_ids = tokenizer.encode(full, add_special_tokens=False)
    type_ids = full_ids[len(context_ids):]
    match = 'SAME' if type_ids == bare_ids else 'DIFFERENT'
    print('  ' + t + ': bare=' + str(bare_ids) + ', in_context=' + str(type_ids) + ', ' + match)

print()
print('=== First token stability check ===')
all_types = scierc_types + docred_types
stable = 0
unstable = 0
for t in all_types:
    bare_ids = tokenizer.encode(t, add_special_tokens=False)
    full = context + t
    full_ids = tokenizer.encode(full, add_special_tokens=False)
    type_ids = full_ids[len(context_ids):]

        stable += 1

        unstable += 1
        print('  UNSTABLE first token: ' + t + ' bare_first=' + str(bare_ids[0]) + ' ctx_first=' + str(type_ids[0] if type_ids else -1))

print('Stable: ' + str(stable) + '/' + str(len(all_types)))
if unstable == 0:
    print('All first tokens stable across contexts -- masking is SAFE')
else:
    print(str(unstable) + ' types have unstable first tokens -- NEEDS FIX')
"
